Export for Claude

A small TSV for your weekly update: words whose status changed, plus words you looked up (a Known word looked up again = forgotten). Uses the K / L codes of known-words.txt, with F for Fresh.

Import

Your word list

known-words.txt format: word⇥K|L⇥date. K → 熟 Known, L → 學 Learning, F → 新 Fresh. A line with only a word counts as Known.

Backup

Everything the extension knows, in one file. Use it to move to another browser or computer, or before reinstalling.
